name: snowsync
source:
This is a collection of real events which occurred somewhere in 2023-2024, and the thoughts i had back then. Inspired by [url=https://yukimisoft.itch.io/if-you-stay]"If You Stay"[/url] , though thematically, it's quite a bit different!

[From [url=https://aira2.itch.io/snowsync]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作收录了2023—2024年间真实发生的若干片段，以及当时的我脑海中所浮现的思绪。灵感源自[url=https://yukimisoft.itch.io/if-you-stay]《If You Stay》[/url]，不过在主题基调上可谓大不相同！

[摘自[url=https://aira2.itch.io/snowsync]itch.io[/url]]
